messages.en:
{07 00 00}So I've been toying around
with interior design lately.

{07 0d 00}I like to keep my house
on the edge of style,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Ma olen viimasel ajal
sisekujundusega mänginud.

{07 0d 00}Mulle meeldib hoida oma
kodu stiili tipptasemel,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}I totally fell in love with
this new furniture I got,
{04 1f 00}.
{07 07 00}Sometimes it's weird
thinking about what life was
like before I had it.{01 00 00 0a 00}{07 00 00}
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Ma armusin täiesti sellesse
uude mööblisse, mille sain,
{04 1f 00}.
{07 07 00}Vahel on imelik mõelda,
milline elu enne seda
oli.{01 00 00 0a 00}{07 00 00}

messages.en:
My new furniture is the
best, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}.

{07 00 00}I've totally fallen in love
with it!{01 01 00} {07 14 00}It's a whirlwind
romance!
messages.et:
Mu uus mööbel on
parim, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}.

{07 00 00}Ma olen sellesse täiesti
armunud!{01 01 00} {07 14 00}See on tormiline
romaan!
